_comment: Single source of truth for the image pipeline AND the runtime srcset builder. `scripts/compress-images.js` (Node) generates one file per width; `utils/imageHelpers.ts` (Vite) builds the matching <source srcset> from the same widths. Keep them here so the two can never drift. widths: descriptors emitted (largest is also written as the base `name.ext`, smaller ones as `name-<w>.ext`). aspect: [w,h] crop ratio (unchanged from the previous fixed dimensions). Add a width and both the build and the runtime pick it up. quality = base quality (all formats); avifQuality = per-preset AVIF override tuned by the autoresearch encode loop (within 0.02 SSIM of q85, visually verified) — see docs/autoresearch-perf-loop.md.
